title: Chanticleer and Tradewinds clubs; closing
summary: He clarifies where he played the Chanticleer and Tradewinds; the tape ends on a gambling club question.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Lee, didn't you play a lot in D.C.? Weren't you at the Chanticleer nightclub?
The Chanticleer is in Baltimore. And I played it to Tradewinds in Washington, D.C. And a Chanticleer in Washington, D.C. at 14th and K.
I see. Lee, wasn't there one club you worked at? It was a gambling place and they broke it up. And then it was back in full swing.
